metadata.description: zaku: design doctrine as skills, and the checker and Figma bridge that enforce it.

plugins.name: zaku
plugins.description: This organization's design doctrine, carried as skills: where a product's design lives as data, how a screen is mapped before it is drawn, how a frame is drawn from the library, how the library follows the code's preset, how a design change is reviewed with evidence, and how an outside fact a decision rests on is researched. Figma is the drawing tool; its spellings live in each skill's references/figma.md. Ships the zaku MCP server, which drives the zaku Figma plugin and checks every script it runs.
